## PAGE: Methodology
URL: https://www.aitoolcrux.com/methodology
Title: Our Review Methodology | AIToolCrux

We use a six-dimension scoring system for every AI tool:
1. Features (25%): Breadth and depth of functionality
2. Ease of Use (20%): Learning curve and user experience
3. Performance (20%): Speed, accuracy, and reliability
4. Value for Money (15%): Pricing relative to capabilities
5. Support (10%): Customer service and documentation quality
6. Innovation (10%): Unique features and advancement

All tools are tested hands-on by our editorial team. Ratings are updated regularly.
Affiliate relationships do not influence ratings or rankings.

- Pi by Inflection: 7.8/10 - Best for: Best for emotional support, conversational, personal assistant
